name: Matsunoyama (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Matsunoyama town emblem in white: an outlined ring with four small bars enclosing three vertical bars.
history: Flag of the former town of Matsunoyama in Niigata Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-04-01.

features.role: Matsunoyama town emblem — an outlined ring with four small bars enclosing three vertical bars
